detections.evidence_quote: When you're under that amount of stress, weight is gonna come on, inflammation is gonna increase, your sleep is gonna be all jacked up.
detections.summary: Host explains good and bad stress, the stress-hormone response, and how major life stressors throw off weight, inflammation, sleep and glucose.

detections.evidence_quote: So this is going to lead to eventually adrenal burnout where your poor adrenal glands are so damn tired, they cannot produce enough cortisol, epinephrine, and norepinephrine.
detections.summary: Host says stress pumps out epinephrine, norepinephrine and cortisol until the adrenal glands burn out and cannot produce enough.

detections.evidence_quote: adrenal burnout where your poor adrenal glands are so damn tired, they cannot produce enough cortisol
detections.summary: Host asserts that chronic stress exhausts the adrenal glands ('adrenal burnout'), causing fatigue and weight gain.

detections.evidence_quote: Weight gain. comes in when your adrenal glands are tanked out.
detections.summary: Weight gain is attributed to tanked-out adrenal glands.

detections.evidence_quote: weight is gonna come on
detections.summary: High life stress is said to make weight come on.

detections.evidence_quote: And we know when we're not sleeping, our insulin regulation goes off the charts, glucose, why am I getting a 120 or a 180 reading on my glucometer?
detections.summary: Host says stress wrecks sleep, poor sleep throws off insulin regulation, and stress explains high glucometer readings even after eating only steak.

detections.evidence_quote: you're providing your body with that building block of the stress hormones so that you become more resilient to stress
detections.summary: Host says L-tyrosine improves mood via dopamine and supplies the building block of stress hormones, making people more resilient to stress.

detections.evidence_quote: So when we come out of that deep depressed state, when we come out of that low mood state, we have more energy.
detections.summary: Host says L-tyrosine supports neurotransmitters and raises dopamine, lifting people out of a depressed, low-mood state.

detections.evidence_quote: So you want to think of dopamine as that burst of feel good.
detections.summary: Host contrasts serotonin as the 'happy hormone' with dopamine as the 'feel good hormone' stimulated by drugs, sex, gambling and chocolate.

detections.evidence_quote: If you think of antidepressants, it's selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
detections.summary: Antidepressants named as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors to illustrate serotonin's link to mood.

detections.evidence_quote: in addition to supporting our thyroid hormone production, all of that can stack upon itself and help with weight.
detections.summary: Host says L-tyrosine supports adrenals and thyroid hormone production and raises energy, which helps with exercise and weight loss.

detections.evidence_quote: it contains a bioactive compound called forscolin, which this has been studied for decades, decades, for its effects on weight loss.
detections.summary: Host describes Coleus forskohlii/forskolin as a mint-family plant studied for weight loss that raises cAMP and promotes lipolysis and fat loss.

detections.evidence_quote: your basal metabolic rate is in the toilet. Maybe it's down to 500 calories a day. but you're eating 3,000 calories a day and you have a thyroid problem on top of that
detections.summary: Host argues that with hypothyroidism and a very low basal metabolic rate, gaining five pounds of fat over a weekend of overeating is possible.

detections.evidence_quote: The more stress that you're under, the more epinephrine and norepinephrine and cortisol is pumped out.
detections.summary: Stress-hormone secretion is offered as the mechanism leading to adrenal burnout.

detections.evidence_quote: because it can improve your mood because it helps produce dopamine.
detections.summary: Dopamine production is offered as the mechanism for L-tyrosine improving mood.

detections.evidence_quote: L-tyrosine can also increase energy by supporting thyroid function and the production of dopamine, norepinephrine, epinephrine.
detections.summary: Thyroid support and catecholamine production are offered as the mechanism for L-tyrosine's energy effect.

detections.evidence_quote: this has been studied for decades, decades, for its effects on weight loss.
detections.summary: Forskolin is said to have been studied for decades for weight loss, with no study identified.

detections.evidence_quote: Horsicolin activates an enzyme called adenylate cyclase.
detections.summary: Forskolin's activation of adenylate cyclase and raised cAMP is offered as the mechanism for fat breakdown and weight loss.

detections.evidence_quote: And I will literally hear my patients say, no, I put on five pounds of fat over the weekend.
detections.summary: Host cites patients reporting gaining five pounds of fat over a weekend as grounds for discussing rapid weight gain in hypothyroidism.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The more stress a person is under, the more epinephrine, norepinephrine and cortisol the body secretes.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The more stress that you're under, the more epinephrine and norepinephrine and cortisol is pumped out.
verification_candidates.rationale: Physiological claim about the stress-hormone response that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Chronic stress eventually leads to adrenal burnout, in which the adrenal glands become too tired to produce enough cortisol, epinephrine and norepinephrine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So this is going to lead to eventually adrenal burnout where your poor adrenal glands are so damn tired, they cannot produce enough cortisol, epinephrine, and norepinephrine.
verification_candidates.rationale: Adrenal fatigue is a contested diagnosis; the claim should be checked against endocrinology evidence.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Burned-out adrenal glands cause fatigue, a 'wired but tired' feeling and weight gain.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So this is where the fatigue comes in or the feeling of being wired but tired. Weight gain. Weight gain. comes in when your adrenal glands are tanked out.
verification_candidates.rationale: Attributes symptoms and weight gain to a contested adrenal condition.

verification_candidates.claim_text: L-tyrosine improves mood because it helps produce dopamine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So using L-tyrosine, in addition to it literally improving your mood, because it can improve your mood because it helps produce dopamine.
verification_candidates.rationale: Supplement efficacy claim for mood that listeners may act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Taking L-tyrosine provides the building block of stress hormones and makes a person more resilient to stress.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: you're providing your body with that building block of the stress hormones so that you become more resilient to stress
verification_candidates.rationale: Supplement benefit claim for stress resilience that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: High levels of life stress cause weight gain, increased inflammation and disrupted sleep.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: When you're under that amount of stress, weight is gonna come on, inflammation is gonna increase, your sleep is gonna be all jacked up.
verification_candidates.rationale: Causal claim about stress's effects on weight, inflammation and sleep.

verification_candidates.claim_text: When people are not sleeping, their insulin regulation and blood glucose go off the charts.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And we know when we're not sleeping, our insulin regulation goes off the charts
verification_candidates.rationale: Causal claim linking sleep loss to glucose dysregulation.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Stress can produce glucometer readings of 120 to 180 even when a person has eaten only a steak.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: why am I getting a 120 or a 180 reading on my glucometer? Well, because you're under stress. All I ate was a steak, well, because you're under stress.
verification_candidates.rationale: Specific claim that stress alone raises blood glucose to these levels.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Eating chocolate increases dopamine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: even eating chocolate increases your dopamine.
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable neurochemical claim about a food.

verification_candidates.claim_text: L-tyrosine supports the adrenals and thyroid hormone production, and these effects can help with weight loss.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: in addition to supporting our adrenals, in addition to supporting our thyroid hormone production, all of that can stack upon itself and help with weight.
verification_candidates.rationale: Supplement claim for thyroid support and weight loss that listeners may act on.

verification_candidates.claim_text: L-tyrosine increases energy levels by supporting thyroid function and the production of dopamine, norepinephrine and epinephrine.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: L-tyrosine can also increase energy by supporting thyroid function and the production of dopamine, norepinephrine, epinephrine.
verification_candidates.rationale: Supplement efficacy and mechanism claim.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Forskolin, a compound in Coleus forskohlii, has been studied for decades for its effects on weight loss.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: it contains a bioactive compound called forscolin, which this has been studied for decades, decades, for its effects on weight loss.
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about the research base for a weight-loss supplement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Forskolin activates the enzyme adenylate cyclase, which increases cyclic AMP levels in cells.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Horsicolin activates an enzyme called adenylate cyclase.
verification_candidates.rationale: Biochemical mechanism claim that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: By raising cAMP, forskolin increases lipolysis and reduces fat accumulation, helping with weight loss.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And then this is one of the mechanisms which for Skolan can actually help with weight loss.
verification_candidates.rationale: Weight-loss efficacy claim for a supplement.

verification_candidates.claim_text: It takes 3,500 calories to equal one pound of fat.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Because we know it takes 3,500 calories to equal one pound.
verification_candidates.rationale: Common energy-balance rule that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: In someone with a thyroid problem, basal metabolic rate may be down to about 500 calories a day.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: your basal metabolic rate is in the toilet. Maybe it's down to 500 calories a day.
verification_candidates.rationale: Quantitative claim about metabolic rate in hypothyroidism.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A person with low metabolism, a thyroid problem and insulin resistance could put on five pounds of fat in two days of overeating.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Yeah, it is possible that you could put on five pounds in two days
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about the possible rate of fat gain that can be checked against energy-balance evidence.
